name: Ona Ken! 1.6 -You Rei-
source:
This time the story is about Norika, a girl who loves her sex toys. 
A homecoming to reunites her with her cousin Rei. Long ago they made a promise to each other... what do you suppose it was? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133695.html]DLsite English[/url]]

她回家与表亲玲重逢。很久以前，她们曾互相许下约定……你猜那是什么？
